=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/guard_differential.py:683-684 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `matcher_covers` treats the literal `*` as a match-all regex, so a guard matcher changed to `*` passes the differential check even though it is invalid at runtime.
  WHY: The guard can be silently disabled while the check reports no wiring regression; all reviewers rated this BLOCKER except qwen_qwen3_7-plus, which rated it NIT.
- scripts/guard_differential.py:641-644, 690-710 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Python's `json.loads` accepts non-standard constants such as `NaN`, and the timeout check can accept the resulting non-finite value because comparisons with NaN do not report a timeout regression.
  WHY: Invalid settings can pass the differential check even though strict runtime JSON loaders reject them; if NaN is accepted at runtime, timeout enforcement can fail. Severity ratings ranged from BLOCKER to NIT.
- scripts/guard_differential.py: compare_settings_wiring, the `if head_text is not None and head_settings is None:` early return (around line 762-765) and read_settings_text (`except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError): return ""`) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Read failures are converted to empty text and reported as parse failures, obscuring the distinction between an I/O/decode error and malformed settings.
  WHY: Operators receive the same `reason=unparseable` diagnosis for a read failure as for deliberately malformed settings.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
